statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring (CPT 93271) is indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
